title: Hollow Japanese-Style Inari Zushi
description: A unique and delicious twist on traditional Japanese sushi, using hollowed out inari tofu pouches filled with a sweet grape and leaf mixture.

ingredients.name: Green leaves (such as shiso or basil)

instructions: Prepare the grape mixture by whisking together grape juice, rice vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl.
Add chopped green leaves to the grape mixture and stir to combine.
Rinse the inari tofu pouches and pat them dry with a paper towel.
Fill each tofu pouch with the grape mixture, leaving a small border at the top.
Serve the filled tofu pouches chilled, garnished with additional chopped green leaves if desired.
